title: Concept: TLS hostname verifier replaced (java)
description: In java, connection.setHostnameVerifier takes the decision about which host a certificate belongs to away from the platform. A verifier that always answers yes survives every review that only looks at the certificate chain.
applicability: Android, desktop and service code that customises TLS verification; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Any valid certificate intercepts the connection, including traffic that carries credentials; HIGH severity.
